analysis: The PR modifies only docs/developer/test.md. Visible changes: the 'Last updated' date bump, a rewritten SDK 27 release-qualification paragraph (head lines ~996-1004, sharded qualify-sdk-shard jobs, an audit of executed counts, and signing gated on qualify-sdk plus optimized compilation), one added test command (scripts/test-provider-cluster-runtime-models.py), and further documentation changes later in the file (head ~1331-1362) that were truncated from the patch excerpt. The base text shown (lines 2309-2510) and the head text shown (lines 1-463) are non-overlapping excerpts, so the changed regions were only partly visible. I saw no executable code, key handling, attestation logic, wire protocol, cache storage, or authorization changes. Documentation of tests only; no runtime security controls are altered, so threat-model assets and boundaries (T-041 prefix cache, TB-011 and others) are unaffected. The sharded release qualification text states that signing requires qualify-sdk (which audits the executed counts of every shard) and optimized compilation. That is a doc description of a CI gate; the actual workflow files were not supplied, so I cannot verify that the described gate is enforced. This is an unverified contract, not a finding. The truncated patch (hunks at head ~1331-1362) was not fully seen. Low residual risk, since these are documentation changes only.
